d: Part of the OHI Group, IITC delivers enterprise technology and digital solutions that help organisations improve performance, modernise operations, and achieve their business objectives.
IITC welcomes applications from experienced Omani professionals for the position of Application Project Manager.

This is an exciting opportunity to lead enterprise IT and application projects across the full project lifecycle, from planning and implementation through User Acceptance Testing (UAT), go-live, handover, and closure..

We are looking for a collaborative and customer-focused professional who can manage complexity, build strong stakeholder relationships, and drive successful project delivery with clarity and accountability.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering , or a related discipline.
5-10 years of experience managing IT and application projects.
Strong experience in customer-facing project management.
Good knowledge of Waterfall, Agile, and Hybrid delivery methodologies.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, leadership, and presentation skills.
Experience using Microsoft Project, Jira , or Azure DevOps is an advantage.
Previous project delivery experience in Oman or the Middle East is preferred.
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE IN ONE OR MORE OF THE FOLLOWING AREAS

We welcome applications from experienced professionals who enjoy leading complex projects, collaborating with customers and multidisciplinary teams, addressing delivery challenges proactively, and turning project plans into successful business outcomes.
📩 Ready to take the next step in your project management career? Apply now and grow with IITC.
r: li
Manage IT and application projects from initiation and planning through implementation, UAT, go-live, handover, and closure.
li
Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and change requests.
li
Coordinate closely with customers, business stakeholders, technical teams, application vendors, and third-party service providers.
li
Lead requirements coordination, application implementation, system integration, testing, migration, and deployment activities.
li
Maintain project plans, RAID logs, progress reports, dashboards, and supporting documentation.
li
Conduct regular project reviews with customers and management.
li
Proactively manage project risks, escalations, and delivery dependencies.
li
Ensure timely completion, customer acceptance, smooth handover, and formal project closure.

d: As a Senior Data Scientist on the Credit Scoring & Underwriting squad, you'll build the AI/ML models behind our credit insights and the cash flow underwriting products that come next. You'll work with transaction data from millions of bank accounts across Saudi Arabia and the UAE, and your models will end up inside lenders' credit decisions.

You'll be the squad's data scientist, working every day with software engineers and the product team. You'll help decide what's worth modelling, how to measure it, and when a model is ready to show a client. Bank data is messy, and a lot of the interesting work is figuring out what it can and can't tell you.

Lean is the leading financial infrastructure provider in the Middle East. We power some of the region's largest companies with APIs that enable payments, account verification, financial data access, and other critical financial infrastructure.

What started as the region's pioneering Open Banking platform and quickly became the de facto leader in account aggregation and payment initiation in the region is now becoming something bigger: a multi-product infrastructure company powering payments, data, and lending across MENA.

We've processed billions of dollars in transactions. We're trusted by 350+ clients — from Binance and Careem to Etisalat — and backed by General Catalyst, Sequoia, and Shorooq. Our $67.5M Series B was just the beginning. We're expanding into new markets, opening offices, acquiring businesses, and building capabilities that didn't exist here before.
q: 5+ years in data science or ML, with models you built running in production.
Hands-on machine learning expertise across the full ML lifecycle, from feature engineering and experimentation to model deployment.
You’ve built credit risk or underwriting models and has a strong understanding of how models are built and used in lending.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch
You use AI coding tools such as Claude Code every day, for analysis, coding, testing and review
You can explain a model, its assumptions and where it breaks to people who aren’t data scientists, including product managers and lenders’ risk teams
You’re happy owning data science for a squad and setting the standards for how it’s done
Experience in fintech or with financial data
You’ve used transformers or foundation models to improve a model in production
Open banking or bank transaction data
Data engineering, or building data-intensive backend systems
ClickHouse or another analytical database at scale

NB. While we think the above experience could be important, we’re keen to hear from people that believe they have valuable experience to bring to the role. If you identify with the team and mission, but not all of our requirements, then please still apply!!
r: li
You will own the hands-on work across the whole ML lifecycle: feature engineering, experiments, training and deployment
li

Build cash flow and repayment models. That means forecasting a customer's income, spending and balance over the coming months with a clear range around each number, and predicting how they'll repay the loans they already have
li
Decide how we evaluate models, with out-of-time testing and calibration checks, so the results hold up when a lender's risk team looks closely
li
Improve the models behind our existing insights, starting with transaction categorisation and income
li
Deploy and monitor models into production on Lean's ML platform, working with engineers and DevOps
li
Sit in technical sessions with clients' risk teams and explain what the models can and can't tell them
li
Help the rest of the team understand data science/ML and get them excited about what it can do
x: We’re building the financial infrastructure for MENA. Not as a slogan, as a fact.

Since 2019, we’ve become the first regulated Open Banking and Open Finance company operating across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. We’ve processed billions of dollars. We connect millions of accounts. We enable companies like Binance, Careem, and Etisalat to build products that were previously impossible in this region.

Our recent $67.5M Series B from General Catalyst and Sequoia isn’t just validation: it’s fuel. We’re expanding into new markets, launching new products, and setting the pace for what financial innovation looks like in MENA.
We solve hard problems. We move fast. We hold ourselves to a high standard. And we’re looking for people who’ve done this before to help us do it right.
If you’re motivated by building something that lasts, not just something that scales, Lean is where you need to be.

Not only do we offer competitive salaries, private healthcare, and flexible office hours, but we also insist that every member of the team hold a meaningful equity stake in the business to ensure long-term alignment. We'd love you to join us for this journey!

Lean is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

d: Our client is a well-established professional services firm in Kuwait seeking an experienced Tax Lawyer to join its growing tax practice. This is an opportunity for a legally qualified tax professional to advise on complex domestic and international tax matters, with a particular focus on the OECD’s Global Minimum Tax framework (Pillar Two).
The successful candidate will combine strong legal and technical tax expertise with the ability to advise corporate clients on evolving tax regulations and international compliance requirements.
Advise clients on international tax matters, with a particular emphasis on OECD Pillar Two and Global Anti-Base Erosion (GloBE) rules.
Analyse and interpret domestic tax legislation, international tax developments, treaties and regulatory guidance.
Support clients with Pillar Two implementation, including applicability assessments, tax impact analysis, compliance obligations and reporting requirements.
Provide legal and technical advice on corporate taxation, tax structuring and cross-border transactions.
Conduct tax research and prepare legal opinions, technical memoranda and client-facing advice.
Monitor developments in international tax policy and relevant legislation across Kuwait and the wider GCC region.
Work collaboratively with legal, audit and tax advisory professionals on multidisciplinary client engagements.
Develop and maintain strong client relationships, delivering practical, commercially focused tax advice.
q: A recognised law degree (LLB or equivalent).
Between 5 and 15 years of relevant professional experience in tax law or tax advisory.
Current or previous experience working in a law firm, international or regional auditing firm, or professional services tax practice.
Demonstrable experience with OECD Pillar Two, the GloBE rules or the implementation of global minimum taxation.
Fluency in both Arabic and English, written and spoken.
Strong legal research, analytical, drafting and client advisory skills.
The ability to interpret complex legislation and communicate technical issues clearly to clients.
Knowledge of Kuwait and GCC tax frameworks and regulatory developments.
Experience advising multinational groups on international tax matters.
Exposure to corporate income tax, transfer pricing, tax treaties and cross-border tax planning.
Experience supporting tax compliance, tax risk assessments and implementation projects relating to Pillar Two.
Commercially minded, with strong attention to detail.
Confident communicating with clients and senior stakeholders.
Proactive in keeping abreast of international tax developments.
Able to manage multiple assignments and work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.

The role offers the opportunity to contribute to a developing international tax practice, advise a diverse client base and build specialist expertise in one of the most significant changes to the international corporate tax landscape.
Confidential applications: Interested candidates are invited to submit a CV outlining their relevant tax law experience, Pillar Two exposure, language capabilities and current location.

d: Responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and optimizing telecommunications networks and infrastructure to ensure reliable connectivity and efficient communication services. Configure network equipment, monitor system performance, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and support the deployment of wired and wireless communication solutions. Conduct technical assessments, prepare engineering documentation, and collaborate with IT, network operations, and project teams to improve network reliability, capacity, and performance while ensuring compliance with industry standards.

Responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining security systems to protect organizational networks, infrastructure, applications, and sensitive information from cyber threats. Monitor security events, identify vulnerabilities, conduct risk assessments, and implement appropriate security controls and preventive measures. Support security incident investigations, vulnerability management, access control, and security testing. Collaborate with IT and infrastructure teams to strengthen cybersecurity policies, maintain regulatory compliance, and improve the organization's overall security posture.
Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of telecommunications infrastructure, network architecture, and cybersecurity principles.
Knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, and network security protocols.
Familiarity with security monitoring, vulnerability assessment, and incident response procedures.
Proficiency in relevant networking, security, and system administration tools.
Strong analytical, technical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
